title: Clown Horn
blurb: Two honks, several centuries of circus heritage, and a devastating verdict. Meme culture assigns this sound to anybody caught mid-clownery: a bad decision visibly in progress, a confidently wrong answer, somebody arguing at length with bait so obvious it was practically labelled. The bulb horn has been shorthand for foolishness since long before the internet existed, which gives it a certain authority the newer options lack. Pairs perfectly with the clown-makeup application meme, applied one layer at a time as the evidence accumulates. Honk honk.
origin: The classic circus bulb horn, meme shorthand for clown behavior.
